echo: We attract potential buyers, but most leave without buying.
h1: GolfBays was losing [[2,499 of every 2,500]] visitors.
context: GolfBays sells golf simulators online and was getting 440,000 Shopify sessions, but with more than 400 products to choose from, most buyers couldn't work out which one was right for them and left without buying.
before_what: “Shop best sellers” and “Book a demo” buttons
after_what: A Conversion Quiz built from their best demos
after_sub: quiz-takers booked a demo or bought
built_1: Turned hundreds of their best sales demos into quiz questions
built_2: Recommended the right sim for each buyer's space and needs
built_3: Sold emotional payoffs, such as Christmas with family in a room that used to sit empty
why: the quiz walked every visitor through the same conversation their best salespeople had on demos, so people who weren't thinking about buying started to, and people who already were felt confident enough to buy, all from the traffic they already had.
up_next: Next question: Where does most of your traffic or audience come from today?
quad: Finding the right trigger, the one that helps you sell to a 20× larger market, is quadrant 1 of the Compounding Revenue Per Visitor™ OS.
